speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether HDB repair services can be expanded to provide support for the elderly, less mobile residents living alone in non-rental flats when they experience problems in their homes like power trips and infrastructure problems.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Essentially, in Toa Payoh where I am at in the constituency, when I go around for block visits, there has been an increasing number of elderly staying alone in their flats, probably in the smaller flats.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: My follow-up question is: in the sense of HDB services that have been provided to rental flats for some of the elderly and more vulnerable residents staying in rental flats, HDB does provide subsidies, from what I hear.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: At the moment, for Toa Payoh, our Town Council and some of our Residents' Committees have actually been helping some of these vulnerable and elderly residents staying alone.
